Package neqsim.process.engineering.model

Class EngineeringDiagramComponentBalanceTable

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.engineering.model.EngineeringDiagramComponentBalanceTable
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public final class EngineeringDiagramComponentBalanceTable extends Object implements Serializable
Immutable, deterministic component-resolved mass-balance projection.

The projection binds explicit component mass-flow records to the explicit stream boundaries in an EngineeringDiagramBalanceTable. It never infers a component slate, converts composition, or changes a governed stream value. Callers must provide one explicit zero or non-zero value for every component on every boundary stream. Missing, duplicate, unknown, wrongly based, and non-finite values remain visible as structured diagnostics.

This class calculates residuals only. It does not apply project tolerances, reconcile data, close equipment heat or work terms, or promote review evidence to engineering approval.
